news.title: AFFLE: Upcoming Results And Trimmed Fair Value Will Guide Measured Outlook

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹8.50 (up from ₹7.15 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹7.35b (up 22% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.19b (up 19% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 16% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 4.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 9.3% growth forecast for the Media industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 14% per year.

news.title: Affle Appoints Sameer Sondhi As Chief Strategic Investments Officer and CEO, North America, Effective January 2, 2026
news.body: Affle announced the appointment of Sameer Sondhi as Chief Strategic Investments Officer, and Chief Executive Officer, North America, effective January 2, 2026. In this senior leadership role, Sameer will be responsible for driving North America expansion plans and new strategic investments aligned with Affle 3i vision of delivering 10x growth in its third decade, centered on the core pillars of Innovation, Impact, and Intelligence. Sameer brings extensive leadership experience in global ad tech and digital media, with a strong track record of scaling revenue in developed markets.
